title: The Cave That Answered Twice
story: Deep in the crystal caverns, Culverbind the Echo Beetle multiplies whenever anyone shouts: every single beetle becomes four beetles at each echo. Mr 6 counts exactly 3 beetles clicking on the wall, and a lost shepherd is about to holler for help — four times before Mr 6 can reach him.
question: If 3 beetles become 4 times as many at each of 4 echoes, how many beetles will there be after the fourth echo?
hint: Multiply by 4 once for each echo — do it one echo at a time and write down each total.
victory: Mr 6 clapped a hand over the shepherd's mouth and whispered the number 768 instead. Culverbind, hearing no shout, had nothing to copy — and shuffled off, lonely and singular.
imagePrompt: A numeral-six knight silencing a startled shepherd in a glittering crystal cavern while clusters of glowing blue beetles ripple across the walls in shimmering echo-light.
